Sam: Heads up — small-batch decode latencies jumped after the kernel switch to flash_v2. Seems specific to decode path when batch_size <= 2 and KV cache is enabled. Quick numbers below.

Maria: Can you paste the perf numbers / profile?

Sam: Sure — ran microbench on g5.2xlarge, single-stream decode with cached KV.

Sam: ```
Baseline (fused_v1 decode, batch=1): p50=38ms p95=72ms tokens/s=210
After auto-select -> flash_v2: p50=52ms p95=120ms tokens/s=170
Regression: p50 +37%, throughput -19%
nsys summary: top stall is cudaMemcpyAsync around KV gather + aten::index_select
```

Josh: Is this affecting prefill too or only decode?

Sam: Only decode. Prefill (long seq causal) looks unchanged — it's the small-step KV read/gather in decode that's spiking.

Anya: My suspicion: flash_v2 expects packed KV layout for fused attention; our paged-attention path keeps KV in fragmented pages and runtime is falling back to a memcpy-heavy gather instead of a direct fused kernel. That would explain the extra memcpy.

Kevin: That matches my read of the nsys trace — multiple small memcpy launches per head. Continuous batching makes it worse because we try to coalesce requests but break KV alignment.

Sam: Minimal repro: single-token decode, heads=32, seq_len_kv=1024. Repro command I used: `python -m bench.decode --model small --batch 1 --steps 200 --kv-cache`

Anya: Quick heuristic idea: force fused_small_batch kernel when avg_tokens_per_request < 8 OR when batch_size <= 2, regardless of auto-select. Also detect fragmented KV pages and do an O(1) compact when cost < threshold.

Kevin: Proposed patch snippet for runtime config: ```json
{"kernel_selection": {"prefer": "auto", "decode_threshold": 4, "force_fused_small_batch": true, "paged_attention_tune": {"compact_threshold": 0.05}}}```

Maria: Can someone run the nsight profiling on decode with `nsys profile --output=decode_kv --trace=cuda,osrt` and paste the timeline? I want the raw events to confirm memcpy frequency.

Anya: On it. Starting a run now (will take ~10m). :coffee:

perf-bot: Perf artifact uploaded: https://perf.redwood/bench/1764829102-decode-kv (contains nsys timeline + nvprof summaries) :eyes:

Josh: If this is reproducible we should revert the auto-select for decode path only and ship the heuristic change. Small-batch decode is higher priority for PLG customers.

Sam: Agreed — I'll open a tiny PR to prefer fused_small_batch for decode and add a flag to opt-in to paged attention during prefill only. Will link PR when ready.

Maria: Thanks — once Anya posts the nsys CSV we'll decide whether to hotfix or include in next weekly release. :+1:
